mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing amitriptyline metabolism via CYP1A2/3A4, while both agents may have additive CNS depressant and anticoagulant effects.
action: Monitor for increased amitriptyline side effects (sedation, anticholinergic symptoms) and bleeding risk; counsel on turmeric dose consistency and consider baseline/follow-up INR if patient on concurrent anticoagulants.
